headline: TRITN collapses 33.33% on heavy selling while PPPM surges 32.26% — a turbulent session dominated by CONS extremes and multi-sigma volume spikes in PROP and PF&REIT.
market_take: Today's digest is split between sharp CONS dislocations (TRITN -33.33% on collapsed volume, PLE -16.67%) and speculative AGRI/F&O bid (PPPM +32.26% on 2.89x volume). PF&REIT and PROP dominate the unusual-trading tape, with B-WORK (13.3σ) and NVD (14.8σ) printing the most extreme volume readings of the day. Several REITs saw large gaps in both directions, reinforcing a risk-off feel at the sub-segment level. Filings add capital-structure and corporate-action noise that ties to several alerted names.

sector_notes.note: AQUA gapped -9.09% on no volume; TKN continued share buybacks on Oct 1-2 while KSL edged up 4.88% on mild volume.
NVD spiked 14.8σ with a -10.13% open gap — a clear distribution signal; EVER printed both a -14.29% gap and a +16.67% intraday recovery, warranting clarification check.
ALLY (5.4σ) coincides with its Oct 2 capital-change filing on offering price and non-Thai nationality list; B-WORK (13.3σ) and M-STOR (3.5σ) also flagged on volume alone.
TRITN -33.33% and PLE -16.67% drag the sector; STPI extended +6.67% with a matching AGM resolution filing on Oct 1; ITD's President resigned per Oct 2 filing.
PPPM +32.26% with 2.89x volume is the standout mover; TL remains under a high-impact set_clarification on its Q2/2026 financial statements from Oct 2.
DCON slipped -5.88% alongside an Oct 2 AGM resolution filing on PRIN shareholder rights — no volume abnormality.
